name: Hasugsaengi Jeonbu Minyeoibnidaman? SEASON 2
source:
“Looking for someone to run the boarding house once again!”

The FMV romance simulation [Five Hearts Under One Roof] returns with Season 2!

Step into the shoes of Yuman once again and run a love-filled boarding house alongside six charming heroines.

Season 2 brings back fan favorites Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung,
now joined by three new tenants, each with their own unique charm.

Experience heart-fluttering new stories and see how much the girls have grown.

In the end… who will stay by your side?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731020/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof_season2/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“再次寻找人来管理寄宿处！”

FMV浪漫模拟游戏《同一屋檐下的五心》第二季回归！

再次扮演玉曼，与六位迷人的女主人公一起经营一家充满爱的寄宿公寓。

第二季回归了深受粉丝喜爱的Mal-sook、Gran和Min-jung，
现在加入了三位新租户，每一位都有自己独特的魅力。

体验令人心潮澎湃的新故事，看看女孩们成长了多少。

最终……谁会留在你身边？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731020/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof_season2/]Steam[/url]]
